recipes.name: Luscious Slush Punch
ingredients_raw: 2 (3 ounce) packages strawberry flavored Jell-O® mix
2 (2 liter) bottles lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage

steps.text: Bring water, sugar, and strawberry-flavored gelatin to a boil in a large saucepan; boil for 3 minutes. Stir in pineapple juice, lemon juice, and orange juice.
Divide mixture between 2 freezer-safe containers. Cover and freeze until solid, at least 8 hours.
Combine contents of 1 container frozen juice mixture with 1 bottle lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage in a punch bowl; stir until slushy. Repeat with remaining portions as needed.

raw_recipe.headline: Luscious Slush Punch
raw_recipe.description: This slushie recipe makes a fruity, fizzy, pineapple-strawberry non-alcoholic punch that kids and adults alike will find refreshingly delicious!

review.reviewBody: This had a lovely red color, and tasted great! I found it definitely takes pre-planning, though, you'll need at least an hour for the punch to cool enough to pour into containers and then into the freezer. I've found one batch fits perfectly into 2 1-gallon Ziploc freezer bags. Just one night's freezing left it at the perfect slushy consistency, more than that and you have a solid, unpourable block o' frozen liquid. I suspect if we take the second bag out and put it in the fridge overnight, it should again be the perfect consistency.

I made this punch for my daughter's wedding and it was fabulous! I made it a couple of weeks before the wedding and froze it in freezer bags as another reviewer had suggested, & layed the bags on their sides on a cookie sheet to freeze so the frozen liquid would not be very thick. Mixing it was a breeze. We placed a bag of the frozen punch in a roaster pan, gradually added the lemon lime soda and used a potato masher to mix it into a slushy icy mixture. We then poured it into the punch bowl to serve. Everyone loved it and many many compliments were received. I will definately make this punch again. It is so easy to make and so convenient to make it ahead of time and have it frozen and ready to go at any given moment....just add lemon lime soda and you have instant punch! I froze half of one of the batches I made in ice cube trays in case I needed to add it to the punch when it began to melt & get warm but it never had the chance to loose it's slush! I had some of the cubes left and they have been great to use to mix up a cup or two of punch at a time. Adding a shot of Vodka to a cup of punch is also pretty tasty! 
You can't go wrong with this punch!
Thanks Valerie for sharing it!!

I made this for girls night and it was a big hit. I spiked it and added 2c vodka and 1 1/2 c triple sec to the mix before I froze it. With booze in it, it does make a nice slushy mix which is easy to scoop out and mix with 7-up. I only used 1 and 1/2 cup sugar, as noted by others. Was asked for the recipe 3 times. Will make again for sure.

Perfect punch recipe! Our guests loved everything about it. I even added in some fruit that I chopped up with my slap chopper- maraschino cherries, crushed pineapple, and mandarin oranges. If you'd like it spiked add in bourbon or rum. Tip: pour cooled mixture in freezer bags as shown but only fill up 1/2 way then freeze them. If you fill them too full it will take a long time to freeze. You could also add the fruit to the bottom of a bundt pan and then pour the mixture over the fruit before freezing to make a beautiful ice ring.

I just hosted an eclipse party, and this pretty, frothy, slushy punch was perfect for a hot summer afternoon. I found this recipe made exactly enough for two punch bowl sized batches. I cut way back on the sugar by using sugar free jello, only 1 cup sugar, and pouring over a two-liter of sugar free Squirt over each batch. It was perfect and definitely did not need to be sweeter. I made it days ahead and froze it in two gallon sized freezer bags which I stored flat in the freezer. On party day, I moved the frozen punch to the refrigerator for one hour and then thawed the first bag another hour on the counter. It was right at slush stage at that point and I added it to the punch bowl and poured over the Squirt. Since we had kids here, I served them the punch out of the bowl, but I added a shot of sparkling wine (you don't need to buy the expensive stuff since you're mixing) in the adult cups before pouring the slush punch over. Everybody LOVED the stuff. Not a drop left.

We make this regularly for parties and it’s always a hit with the kids. I usually freeze it in batches (ziplock bag in a loaf pan works great for portioning) and then mix each block with sprite or similar soda. Usually end up with four portions, and I also cut the sugar by at least one cup

This was very well received at our church function. I used 1 cup of sugar instead of 2.5 and it was the perfect amount of sweetness. I used 4 large Ziploc bags, filled them by lining a pitcher with a bag (it help to have 2 people do this part because the ziploc bag can slide down), and froze them on a cookie sheet overnight . Took them out 2 hours before serving. The first batch I did have to break into medium large sized pieces before putting in the punch bowl with the 7 up about 1 hour before service, and at service it just required taking a large spoon and breaking some of the pieces into smaller chunks and stirring. The second bowlful about 30-45 min later was perfect texture without doing anything. This will be my go to punch recipe. So easy because it is prepared ahead and everyone loved it!

Wow! Excellent slush punch. The taste is excellent and received rave reviews from my guests. One recommendation. Freeze in smaller quantities. I froze the mixture in 4 Tupperware containers. Set out the frozen slush to thaw a couple of hours before use. I used 1 liter of 7 up and 2 Tupperware containers for the first fill of the punch bowl. This is an excellent punch! Enjoy!

I have made this recipe for years! 
First off, I follow the recipe by make these modifications. Instead of the lemon juice I add a can of frozen lemonade. I also add strawberries, blueberries, Sliced lemons and oranges (remove peel if you want), only use 1 1/2 c sugar. 
Use a large ladel to pour into gallon zip lock containers 2 is perfect I double line mine to prevent leaks! 
Other reviewers said it was completely frozen- it will be! You have to let thaw for around 3 hours before serving! If that still isn’t enough time put in microwave! You want it to be unthawed enough to take a fork/ knife and chop up in punch bowl to create a slush. Then pour your ginger ale, I got a flavored cranberry ginger ale and regular and plan on using both. The recipe is very flexible to your likes, so you can play around with flavors, ingredients, and fruit!

I have been making this punch for the last two Christmases and my family really likes it, especially my great nieces. So I just made it this past weekend for my mother's 80th birthday party. I needed to change the color so I substituted strawberry Jello with Jello's Island Pineapple flavor. Beautiful color, rave reviews!!! My husband, who drinks nothing but soft drinks normally, liked it as well. I used every bit of the prepared recipe with people asking for more. Great substitution to a great recipe.

I followed the recipe as stated with 2 modifications: I used vegetarian jelly (jello) mixes from the Mideast market instead of general supermarket jello mix which contains gelatin and isn't suitable for vegetarians/vegans or those who eat only halal or kosher products. And secondly, I used 1 cup of raw sugar rather than what the recipe calls for. For the lemon juice part, I hand-juiced about 3 large lemons to get the 2/3 cup. The frozen mixtures were pulled out of the freezer the morning of a baby shower and set on the counter to thaw for a few hours before going into a mason jar drink dispenser. I used Sprite lemon-lime soda. Really delicious! Everyone loved it.
Every time I have made this, it has been raved about! I use it for our youth group at church, birthday parties, and graduation parties. A little effort, but so worth it!!!
I have used this recipe for years! Everyone always loves it!
I made this recipe as is for my daughter's sweet 16. Too sweet for us adults lol, but the kids liked it. I'm doing it again this Thanksgiving but cutting the sugar to 1 1/2 cups.
Everyone asks for this recipe when I serve it at a party. It’s the best!
I make this for my family Christmas every year and there is never any left. The only thing I change is the amount of sugar as it's too sweet in my opinion. Other than that it's so DELICIOUS!!

I made it for a party at a friends house, it felt awkward when the slushie wasn't completely melted in the ginger ale mixture. Once it melted the people enjoyed it but it was a bit too sweet for everyone except the kids who went. I would add a bit less sugar, but everything else is the perfect amount.
This is the best punch ever ! We have it fot every event , holiday or made up excuses. I have made strawberry , cherry, orange and lime.. all are delicious.
